Requirement: Same sensor model or declared compatible model; matching firmware, measurement mode, optical path, range, integration settings, and processing configuration
Stationary node has a current calibration and verification record against appropriate traceable or certified standard(s)
Mobile and stationary sensors measure the same well-mixed water or controlled reference condition at the same time
Evidence retained: Paired time series and placement record

Requirement: Fit and retain a model mapping raw mobile readings to stationary-reference-equivalent values
Co-location spans the expected field range for the parameter, including low/background and event-relevant conditions
Reserve paired observations or run a second independent co-location check
At the beginning and end of each mobile deployment, compare mobile readings against the stationary node or an independently verified check
Inspect/clean as protocol permits; record sensor condition and out-of-range behavior
Evidence retained: Inspection record, fouling status, maintenance record

Requirement: Set a maximum age and invalidation triggers for the transfer relationship
Route large discrepancy, range extrapolation, stale calibration, or missing provenance to review
